## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature solves. What pain point does it address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution in detail.

### User Experience

How will users interact with this feature?

```
Example usage:
You: [user input]
Agent: [expected response]
```

### Technical Approach

How should this be implemented? (Optional — maintainers may suggest alternatives)

- Component/file changes needed
- New dependencies
- API changes

## Alternatives Considered

What other solutions did you consider? Why is this approach better?

## Additional Context

- Screenshots, mockups, or diagrams
- Related issues or PRs
- Links to similar features in other tools

- [ ] [Criterion 1]
